Love songs of joy make us happy, but songs of heartbreak make us sink in sorrow. It hurts like a night without stars or an apple tree without flowers.
But let bygones be bygones. Que sera sera. Stop asking why love changed without reason. You endure despite the ache. Time will prove that someone new will come along to make your heart colorful again.
Pray for his happiness, even as you release him with a trembling heart. Keep walking with courage. Let the evening tears wash away old dreams, and let the morning sunlight heal your wounded heart. It is time to start your new story.
